Welcome to the 6abc Action News YouTube channel, where you can find stories and video that matter to the Delaware and Lehigh Valleys.

Action News has been the region's number one news source for decades on television, and we're excited to continue that relationship with you right here in YouTube.

Don't forget, you can be part of the Action News team too.  Send us your video using #6abcAction or by email to JoinTheAction@6abc.com .
